name: horse_archer
description: a Horse Archer, a dark-haired rider in a blue padded tunic with white fur trim and a red sash, a tall blue pointed cap with a white fur brim and a red tassel, a quiver of white-fletched arrows at the saddle behind him, drawing a wooden recurve bow held in his LEFT hand with the arrow drawn back by his RIGHT hand, riding a light-brown horse with a dark-brown mane and tail, a white blaze, a red saddle cloth and dark hooves
hands: the bow stays in the rider's left hand on the screen-right side and his right hand on the screen-left side draws the string and the arrow
